about_the_game:
Welcome to the garden, where only the crunchiest survive.

Veggie Brawl is a fast-paced, no-frills multiplayer party game for 2 to 10 players. It’s a full-blown vegetable food fight where friendships are tested, dignity is lost, and the losers? Let’s just say… they’re getting chopped.

There are no farming mechanics. No recipes. No serious strategies. Just three rounds of unfiltered chaos where you chuck cucumbers, slap tomatoes, and try not to get turned into a side dish.

Whether you’re hosting game night or just need a good laugh, Veggie Brawl delivers quick, deliciously stupid fun for you and your produce-flinging pals.

⸻

Features

• Multiplayer Madness

No solo mode. No bots. Just you, your friends, and a whole lot of badly-behaved vegetables.

• Zero Brainpower Required

If you can throw, dodge, and scream at your monitor, you’re already halfway to greatness.

• Fast Rounds, Faster Regrets

Each match is over in minutes—just enough time to ruin a friendship or two.

• Perfect for Parties

Loud, dumb, and dangerously addictive. Ideal for streamers, sleepovers, and passive-aggressive rivalries.

• Unreasonably Dramatic Produce

From a zen broccoli trying to “blend in,” to a tomato who’s fully embraced his ketchup destiny, each character brings their own flavor to the chaos.

⸻

Tagline:

You’re not getting tossed in a salad. Not today.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.5GHz or AMD Phenom 2.5GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or ATI Radeon HD 5850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.2GHz or AMD 4.0GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 270X or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Veggie Brawl is a multiplayer game where 10 vegetables fight in 3 rounds. The last veggie standing wins, while the 9 losers turn into a salad! Each veggie has unique abilities, and players must strategize to survive. Only the strongest veggie avoids becoming a salad!
